text:
Situation: Palonosetron hydrochloride injection from Teva Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc. is discontinued per FDA records. Corvale East holds 84 units with a daily use of 4.5, providing 19 days of supply. No public FDA shortage signal exists for palonosetron at our plants today.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage list records Teva Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc. palonosetron hydrochloride injection as discontinued with an initial posting date of 2025-11-14.

Our position: Current inventory covers approximately 19 days. Alternative manufacturers are not on FDA's shortage list today. Procurement must shift to available suppliers to maintain continuity.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Apotex Corp. for palonosetron injection; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
2. Buyer to evaluate Avyxa Pharma, LLC as secondary source; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
3. Buyer to evaluate BluePoint Laboratories as tertiary source; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
4. Buyer to evaluate Baxter Healthcare Corporation as quaternary source; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time; those decisions remain with treating clinicians and the committee.
